verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials, such as OAuth scopes or permission-limited tokens, for an agent. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: admin approval of MCP client integrations, choosing which events to subscribe to, and a bare mention that the OpenAPI spec covers user and bot token usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
